core_meaning.primary_meaning: Muslimin is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Muslims”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Muslimin corresponds to the Arabic form مُسْلِمِين (Arabic root س ل م (s-l-m); مُسْلِمِين (Muslimīn)). Its core sense is muslimin; muslims (plural). Muslimin is Arabic مُسْلِمِين (Muslimīn) 'Muslims', the plural of مُسْلِم (muslim), from the root س ل م (s-l-m). The source gloss 'Muslim' is broadly consistent. Recorded as a plural form also used as a given name.
